t: My father and I are changed humans after this purchase
x:
Your first question might be, "why does this woman think she's so very changed by a whiteboard?" Well, my reason is sound, as you'll find out if you keep reading.
First, the integrity of the board. Sturdy, good packaging, arrived intact, looks like a lovely whiteboard. Zero complaints. Lovely size for what I needed.
Why I needed it, is why my father and I are changed humans.
My father has worked for the same place since 1974 and just retired back in February. When I was a small child I used to go to take your kid to work days and waaaaay back when he had a whiteboard in his office and I climbed up on a stool and used one of his dry erase markers to write, "I love you daddy" on it. Well, he kept it. Moved that whiteboard all over buildings with him. I didn't know until we fast forward to 4 years ago and we had a bring your family day and I walk in and there's the board with my scrawl from so many years before. I added to it that day by writing the same sentiment right above it and circling it with a little cloud shape. (Full disclosure: I cried.) Fast forward to around 2 1/2 years ago when I started working there, too, and I see his office again and to welcome me, he wrote that he loved me, too, above it. Well, we found out he could not take this whiteboard with him. I offered to pay well over what it was worth, to get a new one, everything I could think of and no was the resounding answer. So I hatch a new plan. I go in and take pics on the dl. I order this whiteboard from Amazon. I order sharpies in the right colors so it'll never come off once I do this. I then painstakingly duplicate every single line of it as close to the original scrawl as I can. (I left his off so he could write it himself.) On Christmas day, well after he's vacated his office and we had to erase said board, I gift him this whiteboard. (Full disclosure: we both cried this time.)
We are changed people. This whiteboard literally preserved memories for years to come. And, y'all, when the dreaded day comes that he passes on... that whiteboard will come to live with me. So, you see, this whiteboard has deeply affected our lives.
(Full disclosure: I may cry a lot, because I'm crying again typing this, lol)
